column4: Well, look at these young businesswomen.

Annabelle McNeil: It's our cookies, cake, and lemonade stand.

Andy Fields: Very creative. How's it going so far?

Patty Torres: You're our first customer so far.
But I'm sure, I'm sure, a bajillion customers will be here any minute.

Andy Fields: Do you two know what's happening?
column4: Patty, Annabelle, have either of your parents told you anything about what's going on?

Patty Torres: Um. Last night I woke up because my mom was crying really, really loudly, and then she and my dad started yelling at each other.
When I went out to ask what was happening, she calmed down a little bit, and I went back to bed.
But then this morning I didn't see my mom and my dad was really...
He told me I could have anything I wanted for breakfast, so we made churro waffles like when we go to my abuelita's.
And then Anna came over, and the bake sale was her idea.
And so my dad gave us lots of cookies and some cake and lemonade and made us both sandwhiches, which we ate a little bit ago
But not all them, there are still lots for sale.
I know something bad is happening! I'm not, I'm not...
I'm not stupid just because I'm a kid!

Andy Fields: Annabelle, what did your parents tell you?
column4: Why aren't you at home Annabelle?

Annabelle McNeil: I saw it on the TV, while my parents were watching.
They didn't know I was looking.
And then they started opening all of their bottles and drinking.
Some of their friends came over and they started hugging me and crying and told me to go play with Patty.
Do you want to buy something or not.

column4: I'm sorry, I wish I could... I'm sorry

Patty Torres: What? What's happening? Why is no one here?

Andy Fields: I actually do need some cake.

Annabelle McNeil: Why do you want the cake?

Andy Fields: Miranda and Angie are getting married. Down at the skate park in a little bit, actually. Can't have a wedding without cake.
column4: A wedding. Angie and Miranda are getting married. We're meeting up at the skate park soon.

Andy Fields: Of course, I'm sure Angie and Miranda would love to see you both there.

Annabelle McNeil: Don't worry Miss Fields, you can have all the cake you need.

Patty Torres: We can't just give her the cake for free.
What kind of business women would we be if we did that.

Andy Fields: I can give you [highest value item] and do a skate trick.
